nuc.doctrine.no_first_use.desc: Restrained deterrent posture: -25% triad upkeep and lower diplomatic threat, but bars nuclear first strikes.
nuc.doctrine.escalation_to_deescalate.de: Forward tactical posture: +35% wartime coercion, +25% umbrella weight and faster posture shifts, at +25% triad upkeep and sharper tension.

w5.mod.fiscal_compact.name: Federal Fiscal Compact
w5.mod.fiscal_compact.desc: Revenue-sharing transfers and local investment calm regionalist grievances at a modest tax-collection cost.
w5.mod.crisis_summit.name: Multilateral Crisis Accord
w5.mod.crisis_summit.desc: Diplomatic de-escalation and trade-corridor assurances strengthen market access and sovereign credit terms.
w5.mod.rebuilding_authority.name: National Reconstruction Authority
w5.mod.rebuilding_authority.desc: Streamlined civil tenders accelerate rebuilding and infrastructure output while adding sovereign financing strain.
w5.mod.triad_modernization.name: Strategic Triad Modernization
w5.mod.triad_modernization.desc: Upgraded early-warning radars, submarine patrols and command links bolster national deterrence.
w5.mod.industrial_retooling.name: Industrial Retooling Charter
w5.mod.industrial_retooling.desc: Public-private plant modernization lifts industrial output and research velocity.
w5.mod.civic_consensus.name: Civic Consensus Forum
w5.mod.civic_consensus.desc: Cross-bloc institutional dialogue lowers domestic radicalism and eases reform friction.
w5.mod.verifiers_deployed.name: Mutual Inspection Protocol
w5.mod.verifiers_deployed.desc: On-site arms verification calms international markets and lowers sovereign borrowing costs.
w5.mod.wartime_repatriation.name: Co-Financed Reconstruction Corridors
w5.mod.wartime_repatriation.desc: International rebuilding contractors restore logistics hubs and accelerate civil works.
w5.dec.fiscal_compact.name: Enact Federal Fiscal Compact
w5.dec.fiscal_compact.desc: Negotiate multi-year revenue sharing with restive provinces to dampen regionalist cleavage pressure.
w5.dec.crisis_summit.name: Convene Multilateral Crisis Summit
w5.dec.crisis_summit.desc: Host emergency diplomatic talks to lower geopolitical tension, protect shipping lanes, and steady credit markets.
w5.dec.rebuilding_authority.name: Charter Post-War Rebuilding Authority
w5.dec.rebuilding_authority.desc: Launch a dedicated national reconstruction body to clear war ruin and lift living standards across damaged regions.
w5.dec.rebuilding_authority.unavail: Requires peacetime and a solvent treasury.
w5.dec.triad_modernization.name: Authorize Strategic Triad Modernization
w5.dec.triad_modernization.desc: Fund command-and-control hardening and delivery-system upgrades to reinforce long-term strategic deterrence.
w5.dec.triad_modernization.unavail: Requires 55% literacy and a solvent treasury.
w5.dec.industrial_retooling.name: Launch Industrial Retooling Charter
w5.dec.industrial_retooling.desc: Back domestic industrialists with targeted modernization incentives to boost productivity and research output.
w5.dec.civic_consensus.name: Convene Civic Consensus Dialogue
w5.dec.civic_consensus.desc: Bring reformist, traditionalist, and regional representatives to the table to defuse domestic polarization.
w5.dec.civic_consensus.unavail: Only available when national stability is below 78%.
w5.ev.fiscal_revolt.title: Provincial Revenue Standoff
w5.ev.fiscal_revolt.desc: Governors from poorer peripheral regions accuse the capital of draining local tax bases to finance central priorities, swelling regionalist rallies across provincial assemblies.
w5.ev.fiscal_revolt.con1: Treasury transfers soothe provincial leaders and curb regionalist unrest at a fiscal cost.
w5.ev.fiscal_revolt.con2: Revenue stays in central hands, but provincial alienation deepens.
w5.ev.fiscal_revolt.opt3: Tie Aid to Balanced Regional Budgets
w5.ev.fiscal_revolt.con3: Bondholders applaud fiscal discipline while peripheral households feel the squeeze.
w5.ev.industrial_standoff.title: Industrialists vs. Reformists
w5.ev.industrial_standoff.desc: Major manufacturing chambers demand deregulation and energy subsidies to stay competitive, while urban reformist coalitions press for stronger wage protections and transparency.
w5.ev.industrial_standoff.con1: Productivity rises quickly, though labor groups protest the concessions.
w5.ev.industrial_standoff.con2: Living standards and social stability improve at a moderate budget cost.
w5.ev.security_memo.title: The Security Directorate Memorandum
w5.ev.security_memo.desc: Senior commanders warn that prolonged conflict requires emergency procurement authority and tighter coordination across defense ministries.
w5.ev.security_memo.con1: Army readiness and war resolve strengthen, while civilian oversight narrows.
w5.ev.security_memo.con2: Constitutional legitimacy holds firm even as hawkish factions grumble.
w5.ev.arms_verification.title: Strategic Inspection Impasse
w5.ev.arms_verification.desc: Satellite telemetry has sparked a diplomatic dispute over dual-use missile telemetry and inspection schedules with rival powers.
w5.ev.arms_verification.con1: Transparency calms rivals and lowers sovereign risk spreads.
w5.ev.arms_verification.con2: Deterrence readiness climbs, though international notoriety ticks upward.
w5.ev.doctrine_leak.title: Leaked Strategic Posture White Paper
w5.ev.doctrine_leak.desc: A draft defense review outlining lower thresholds for tactical deterrence has leaked to foreign diplomatic cables, prompting urgent inquiries from neighbors.
w5.ev.doctrine_leak.con1: Regional markets steady and diplomatic friction eases.
w5.ev.doctrine_leak.con2: Hawks rally behind a firmer deterrent line while foreign observers grow wary.
w5.ev.doctrine_leak.con3: Domestic order holds while political capital is spent containing the leak.
w5.ev.consortium_overrun.title: Megaproject Consortium Cost Overrun
w5.ev.consortium_overrun.desc: Rising specialty steel and engineering costs have pushed flagship national infrastructure tenders over budget, testing partner confidence.
w5.ev.consortium_overrun.con1: Construction capacity surges and contractors keep sites moving on schedule.
w5.ev.consortium_overrun.con2: Trade access widens and diplomatic goodwill grows without draining the treasury.
w5.ev.chokepoint_summit.title: Maritime Chokepoint Emergency Conference
w5.ev.chokepoint_summit.desc: Shipping insurers and littoral states have called an urgent summit as freight premiums surge along congested strategic straits.
w5.ev.chokepoint_summit.con1: Market access rebounds and shipping insurers cut emergency surcharges.
w5.ev.chokepoint_summit.con2: Naval crews gain operational experience while rivals bristle at the show of force.
w5.ev.reconstruction_tenders.title: Post-War Reconstruction Contracts
w5.ev.reconstruction_tenders.desc: Civil ministries and foreign lenders are competing over who will finance and execute the next phase of urban grid, rail, and port rebuilding.
w5.ev.reconstruction_tenders.con1: Local living standards and political stability rebound strongly.
w5.ev.reconstruction_tenders.opt2: Bundle Debt Relief With International Tenders
w5.ev.reconstruction_tenders.con2: Sovereign debt eases and logistics rebuild faster, though local firms complain.
w5.ev.grain_energy_corridor.title: Emergency Grain and Energy Corridor
w5.ev.grain_energy_corridor.desc: Commodity inflation has squeezed household budgets across importing states, prompting proposals for a joint neutral transit corridor.
w5.ev.grain_energy_corridor.con1: Inflation cools and households see immediate relief on staples.
w5.ev.grain_energy_corridor.con2: The treasury gains cash, though consumer prices remain elevated.
